# Beba repository instructions

- Preserve the static prototype behavior in `prototype/index.html`.
- Use the numbered `docs/` layout and update relative links whenever files move.
- Keep product decisions separate from implementation plans.
- Do not add secrets, real identity data, phone numbers, payment credentials, or private documents.
- Treat the prototype as a browser-only demonstration, not a production backend.
- Before committing, run `git diff --check` and verify `git status --short --branch`.
